reference.title: Scenario 1 — Image placed inside an admonition
reference.shortdesc: Consider a Warning paragraph where the author has inserted an inline image — for example,

section.p: Consider a Warning paragraph where the author has inserted an inline image — for example, a photograph of a hazardous component — directly inside the same paragraph as the warning text.

row.entry: [Warning style]: Do not touch the marked components. [Inline image inside Warning paragraph: hazard_area.png]

entry.codeblock: <note type="warning"> Do not touch the marked components. <image href="media/hazard_area.png" placement="inline"/> </note>

section.p: Result:The converter extracts the image and preserves it within the <note> element. Since the image is part of the warning statement, it remains inline inside the paragraph.
